exposure: urinary oxidative stress biomarkers (PGF2a, 8-iso-PGF2a, and 8-iso-PGF2a metabolite)
cohort: 740 women from a multi-center prospective cohort study recruited between 2010 and 2012.
finding: Increased oxidative stress, indicated by the 8-iso-PGF2a metabolite, was associated with increased odds of overall preterm birth.
